natural_language: 当 Timer-X 期望间隔已达到 T2 后，每次 2xx 重传都必须为下一 generation 保持 4000 ms cap，匹配 ACK 可提前取消；固定 Doubango 的 timeout <<= 1 无 cap，会产生 8000 ms 及更长间隔，预期违反。
standard_excerpt: The interval starts at T1 seconds and doubles for each retransmission until it reaches T2 seconds.
time_source: 固定 RFC 条款及锁定实现 profile；默认整数毫秒值仅在卡片声明的 profile 下使用。

ap_definitions.timer_x_capped_generation_expected_t2: RAW correlated protocol event with the exact transaction_id and timer_generation retained as fields, not AP names.
ap_definitions.timer_x_deadline: DERIVED logical deadline at stored deadline_tick=arm_tick+configured_delay_ms for this timer_generation; not callback, send, or state transition; suppressed after cancellation.
ap_definitions.matched_2xx_ack: RAW/LATCHED RFC-matched ACK outcome emitted only after correlation and any required timer cancellation; closes this generation.

correlation_key: session_id + top Via branch + CSeq number/method + transaction role; ACK additionally uses RFC matching; timer_generation separates every re-arm/reset
projection_rule: correlate first; exactly one obligation generation per finite word; dynamic identifiers remain event fields; supersession closes the old word before a new monitor is spawned
instrumentation_timing: 每次 Timer-X callback 后，只要 expected_delay_ms 已达 T2，就以 raw_delay_ms 和 expected=min(2*previous,T2) 新建一条 timer_x_capped_generation_expected_t2 投影；deadline 按 4000 ms 期望派生，iACK 成功取消后关闭该 generation。
review_question: 请复核 RFC 角色、时间 profile、AP/correlation 和源码 hook；FIXED_AFTER_AUDIT 不等于 APPROVE。
limitations: EXPECTED_VIOLATION: timeout <<= 1 has no T2 cap; instantiate one monitor for every post-cap generation with raw_delay_ms and expected_delay_ms.
pointwise_semantics: pointwise event positions with absolute integer milliseconds; mathematical_mitl uses standard MITL, while mightyppl_formula uses MightyPPL's weak finite-word G* operator
finite_end_semantics: one correlated obligation generation per finite word; append a terminal position strictly beyond every bounded deadline so the supplied oracle is decisive; no overlapping trigger generations
monitor_instantiation: EXACTLY_ONE_TRIGGER_PER_PROJECTED_WORD; key=transaction_id+timer_kind+timer_generation; append a terminal position after the largest bounded deadline
independent_audit_note: Original disposition=FIX retained; repaired formula/AP/traces/primary and auxiliary source mapping. This is not human approval.
timer_observation_semantics: arm_tick, configured_delay_ms, deadline_tick, callback_tick, action_tick and termination_tick are distinct fields.
audit_disposition_note: Original independent-audit disposition=FIX; all semantic fields are replaced by this override.

title: Matched 2xx ACK suppresses later UAS retransmission
natural_language: 匹配 2xx ACK 已成功取消 Timer X 后，直到 Timer L 或 dialog close 关闭投影，都不得再实际重传该 2xx；同一整数时间戳下若 callback/send 先发生，必须先记录它，再记录 post-cancel trigger。
standard_excerpt: Response retransmissions cease when an ACK request for the response is received.
time_source: 固定 RFC 条款及锁定实现 profile；默认整数毫秒值仅在卡片声明的 profile 下使用。

title: Timer L retains Accepted server transaction for 64*T1
natural_language: 服务事务发送 2xx 并成功以 64*T1=32000 ms 启动 Timer L 后，32000 ms 前不得进入 Terminated 且应在边界终止；RFC 6026 服务侧性质不允许把传输错误当作提前丢弃例外，Doubango 的 Any transport error 路径因此是已知违反。
standard_excerpt: The state machine MUST transition to the Accepted state and set Timer L to 64*T1.
time_source: 固定 RFC 条款及锁定实现 profile；默认整数毫秒值仅在卡片声明的 profile 下使用。

ap_definitions.server_accepted_timer_l_armed: RAW post-schedule one-shot event emitted only after the correlated timer generation is successfully stored; carries arm_tick, configured_delay_ms, deadline_tick, timer_generation, role, and transport.
ap_definitions.server_transaction_terminated: RAW event on every correlated transition to Terminated, irrespective of cause; it is not a timer deadline alias.

title: Timer M 64*T1 lifetime with atomic transport-abort exception
natural_language: 客户端收到 2xx、进入 Accepted 并成功以 64*T1=32000 ms 启动 Timer M 后，正常路径在边界前不得终止且应在边界完成；不可恢复传输错误仅在 client_transport_abort 与 termination 同一 microstep 时允许提前终止。
standard_excerpt: It MUST transition to the Accepted state, pass the 2xx response to the TU, and set Timer M to 64*T1.
time_source: 固定 RFC 条款及锁定实现 profile；默认整数毫秒值仅在卡片声明的 profile 下使用。

ap_definitions.client_transport_abort: RAW correlated unrecoverable transport-failure cause at its actual callback/state-transition tick; never inferred from a missing packet.
